system.description:
Energy Ammo: energy packs weigh 1kg and contain 25 shots. Each pack costs 200cr. Weapons contain enough slots for multiple energy packs, equal to the maximum number of rounds they can fire. Each additional energy pack installed increases the weight of the weapon. All energy weapons can only be fired once every 10-second round due to the extreme cooling needed to prevent burning out the weapon.

Traits

  • Zero-G: Prevents recoil, allowing use in low-to-no gravity without incurring penalties to attacks due to drifting.
